changeinfo.changes: Removed blood from infantry kills Fixed auto take-off not working in Frontline mode

Fixed Frontline mode not updating high scores on campaign completion Fixed trophies sometimes failing to unlock when 2 or more were earned at once Fixed various soft locks caused by pressing controls during dialogue/auto-pilot Fixed an issue where ghost bullets could damage enemies off screen Fixed Hot Potato uploading scores of zero in some instances Fixed being unable to select a direction when using a custom alternate control scheme Improved alternate controls for players that don't hold the direction stick constantly Added a difficulty based score multiplier to all kills in some game modes Train mission no longer spawns before mission 10 Minor graphical improvements Minor text corrections
